 Consumers save 16 trillion VND when shopping during "massive sales" events.
 It is estimated that Vietnamese consumers saved up to 16 trillion VND at the 11-11 sale event.
 Hà Nội Mới • 20/11/2026 Follow Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e Add Vietnam.vn on G o o g l e 0 It is estimated that during the "11-11 Mega Sale of the year," consumers saved approximately 16 trillion VND. Photo: Gia Tuong Shopee, the e-commerce platform, announced on November 20th that, concluding its "11-11 Mega Sale of the Year," the number of orders placed via livestream increased ninefold compared to a normal day. Notably, the total transaction value (GMV) of Shopee Live during the same period also increased twelvefold.
 Besides the effectiveness of interactive channels, products of Vietnamese origin continue to be chosen by consumers. The best-selling product categories include: clothing ( fashion ), facial skincare products, beverages, snacks, and household cleaning products.
 You may also like Alongside platform activities, the seller community is also actively implementing business operations to serve the shopping needs during this period. On peak days alone, the number of new products listed on Shopee increases sevenfold compared to normal days, contributing to expanding the product catalog and choices for consumers. 
 The results from the recent 11-11 shopping event are helping retailers and brands to plan their products and merchandise for the end of the year. Notably, sellers are increasingly proactively utilizing visual content formats to convey product information vividly, answer questions, and reach new customer segments. The number of livestream sessions conducted by sellers and brands on Shopee has tripled compared to normal days. Shopping sessions on Shopee Live and Shopee Video have recorded nearly 2.5 billion views…
 It is estimated that promotional programs and offers from Shopee, brands, and sellers helped users optimize their budgets. Accordingly, Vietnamese consumers saved up to 16 trillion VND through the 11-11 event.
 You may also like A Shopee representative stated that this result demonstrates the role of content commerce and interactive experiences in connecting the needs for discovery , entertainment, and shopping, while expanding business opportunities on the digital platform. In the future, Shopee will continue to invest in technology and solutions to support sellers, partnering with Vietnamese businesses to prepare for the year-end shopping season and Tet (Lunar New Year) 2027.
